propositions: The divergent_implementation axis fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and is the only hard-override axis never properly calibrated with worked examples or a closed grade set, causing 90% of omitted-scope-site findings to be mis-scored as none despite carrying real divergence.

The axis must be graded by divergence kind (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration) instead of ordinal levels, with contradicts_reality and omits_required_site flooring at 0.85 and incomplete_enumeration contributing below every blocking threshold without a hard floor.

The impact_plan function currently resolves divergent_implementation through the generic _SEV01 map keyed only on none|low|medium|high; schema-only changes would silently score new symbolic grades as 0.0, breaking the axis entirely rather than implementing the intended floor.

A prod_impact floor (Fix 2) must be rejected because it collides structurally with the novelty convergence floor (novelty_priority_floor=0.4), allowing non-terminating remediation loops by lifting findings on unbounded severity properties that authors cannot fix by editing the plan.

ADR 0054 must formally reject purpose-built LLM eval suites and bulk re-review runs as calibration instruments, permitting only zero-marginal-cost corpus replay and dogfood-and-observe forms under ADR 0036's permissive-rollout framework.
